bulkMemory.evidence: linear + gc backends: memory.copy (0xFC 10) and memory.fill (0xFC 11) from emit_memory_copy/emit_memory_fill (codegen/common_extractors/common_extractors.vibe), reached from ~18 builtin bodies -- string/array copies and zero-initializing a fresh hash-index table in one instruction instead of a store loop. FOUND BY --scan, not by hand: it was emitted and undeclared

exceptionsFinal.evidence: linear + gc backends: try_table/tag section, emitted only when a module uses effects/throw (codegen/wasi/linked_compile.vibe, codegen/gc/backend_expr.vibe)

gc.evidence: gc backend: struct.new/get/set for the RC cell and non-escaping local records (#1702), array.new_default/get/set/len for the reference lane (#1329/#1541), and the struct/array type definitions they need (codegen/gc/backend_body.vibe, backend_expr.vibe)

simd.evidence: linear + gc backends: v128 opcodes behind specific builtins e.g. simd_skip_ws (codegen/wasm_emit/simd.vibe, codegen/expr/compile_call.vibe)

typedFunctionReferences.evidence: gc backend: `(ref null $t)` in function SIGNATURES, locals, and a reserved blocktype -- the #1541/#1722 reference lane gives private callees typed parameters/results instead of the universal tagged i64 (codegen/gc/backend_body.vibe). Separate from `gc`: a module can use struct/array types with an all-i64 ABI, which is what this backend did before the reference lane
